title: Concept: pnpm dependency resolved as a live directory link
description: pnpm-lock.yaml declares an importer dependency that resolves to a `link:` path instead of a registry version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The dependency reads a live directory, so what compiles depends on the state of that path on the machine and is not frozen by the lockfile.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pnpm-lock.yaml (npm).
risk: The dependency reads a live directory, so what compiles depends on the state of that path on the machine and is not frozen by the lockfile.
